title: A Orbit for the Horizon
premise: Elodie Thackeray hauls seed-stock and soil cultures along the Verge Run, a shipping lane between two colonies that severed contact after the Kessari Massacre — an atrocity every official archive insists never happened. When a distress beacon transmits in Old Meridian, a language extinct for two hundred years, she rescues a survivor carrying proof that the massacre was real and that Earth's governing Concord erased it to protect the terraforming monopoly. Hunted by Concord enforcers and doubted by the very colonies the lie divides, Elodie must deliver the testimony before Earth's final transmission loop closes in forty days, sealing the falsified record forever. She succeeds at terrible cost — her ship, her mentor's legacy, and nearly her life — but the broadcast of truth reunites the estranged worlds and gives her found crew a home among the people they saved.
about_author: Dominic Okafor is a former agricultural engineer who spent six years designing closed-loop hydroponic systems before turning to fiction full-time. He writes from a converted greenhouse in Lagos, where his stories about survival, inheritance, and chosen family take root alongside his orchids.

chapters.title: The Long Route
chapters.summary: Elodie tends the generation-garden aboard her freighter Halcyon Wake, narrating her solitary run between the silent colonies of Verge and Calloway. POV: Elodie. Emotional beat: quiet loneliness disguised as purpose; she gardens for descendants she'll never meet because no one else will.

chapters.title: Signal in a Dead Tongue
chapters.summary: A distress ping arrives encoded in Old Meridian, a language extinct since the Diaspora. Elodie decodes enough to triangulate a wreck drifting in the quarantine belt. POV: Elodie. Emotional beat: unease sharpening into compulsion — someone is speaking from inside a story everyone agrees is over.

chapters.title: The Survivor
chapters.summary: She pulls Iyo Sefu, half-frozen, from the wreck of a Concord survey ship. Iyo carries a data-slate he refuses to explain. POV: Elodie. Emotional beat: wary compassion; two strangers bound by a rescue neither can afford.

chapters.title: What the Slate Says
chapters.summary: Iyo reveals the slate holds raw sensor logs of the Kessari Massacre — twelve thousand dead, officially nonexistent. He was a Concord archivist who stole it. POV: Iyo. Emotional beat: guilt and terror; he knows exactly what the Concord does to thieves.

chapters.title: Forty Days
chapters.summary: Iyo explains Earth's transmission loop: in forty days the archival record resets permanently, erasing any chance of contradiction. They must reach an independent relay. POV: Elodie. Emotional beat: dread crystallizing into resolve; the clock starts here.

chapters.title: Port of Whispers
chapters.summary: They dock at smuggler station Ferrous Deep seeking a relay contact, meeting pilot Renn Okonkwo and medic Ash Vey, who join for payment they can't actually pay. POV: Elodie. Emotional beat: first warmth of found family forming under transactional pretenses.

chapters.title: Enforcers at the Dock
chapters.summary: Concord enforcers board the station hunting a 'data thief.' The crew hides Iyo inside the garden module, among the living green. POV: Renn. Emotional beat: fear braided with unexpected loyalty — Renn lies to authority for the first time in his life.

chapters.title: The Mentor's Shadow
chapters.summary: Flashback chapter: Elodie remembers her mentor Dara Thackeray, who vanished investigating the massacre twenty years ago, leaving her the ship and the silence. POV: Elodie (flashback). Emotional beat: grief reframed — this mission is an inheritance she finally understands.

chapters.title: Calloway Refuses Them
chapters.summary: They reach colony Calloway hoping its council will broadcast the evidence; officials, profiting from Concord contracts, refuse and threaten detention. POV: Iyo. Emotional beat: bitter disillusionment — victims' descendants protecting the murderers' ledger.

chapters.title: Ash's Testimony
chapters.summary: Ash reveals her grandmother survived Kessari and went mute with trauma; the extinct language on the beacon was the colony's old tongue, kept alive in secret. POV: Ash. Emotional beat: personal history igniting into fury and hope; the mission becomes hers too.

chapters.title: Ambush in the Belt
chapters.summary: Concord gunships ambush them in the asteroid belt; Renn flies a brutal evasion through debris, and the Halcyon Wake's hull is breached near the garden. POV: Renn. Emotional beat: terror and exhilaration; the crew stops being hired help and becomes a family under fire.

chapters.title: The Garden Bleeds
chapters.summary: Elodie seals the breach by venting part of the garden she's tended for a decade, sacrificing decades of growth to save Iyo and the slate. POV: Elodie. Emotional beat: mourning made practical; the price of survival measured in uprooted lives.

chapters.title: Verge's Gatekeepers
chapters.summary: At colony Verge, a young archivist named Toma secretly confirms the slate matches sealed family records — but the council arrests Iyo as a destabilizer. POV: Toma. Emotional beat: conscience awakening; one insider chooses truth over career.

chapters.title: Prison Break, Borrowed Wings
chapters.summary: Toma frees Iyo using forged credentials, joining the crew as they flee Verge with enforcers in pursuit. POV: Iyo. Emotional beat: disbelief at being believed; the weight of being worth dying for.

chapters.title: Dara's Cache
chapters.summary: Following coordinates hidden in the ship's original registry, they find Dara Thackeray's abandoned research post — and her own massacre evidence, plus a message naming the Concord official who ordered the cover-up. POV: Elodie. Emotional beat: reunion across death; her mentor speaks at last through the record.

chapters.title: The Traitor Aboard
chapters.summary: Renn confesses he sold their route to the Concord weeks ago for debt forgiveness; the ambush wasn't luck. Betrayal fractures the crew just as the loop deadline nears. POV: Renn. Emotional beat: shame and the terrifying possibility that family can still forgive.

chapters.title: Ninety-Six Hours
chapters.summary: With ninety-six hours left, the only independent relay left is the ancient Meridian deep-space array, guarded by Concord's flagship. Ash proposes using the extinct language itself as an uncrackable broadcast code. POV: Ash. Emotional beat: desperate ingenuity; heritage becomes weapon.

chapters.title: Into the Loop
chapters.summary: Renn flies a suicide-feint run to draw the flagship while Elodie and Iyo board the array. Renn is captured; the plan half-collapses. POV: Elodie. Emotional beat: sacrifice accepted; she leaves him behind because the truth cannot wait.

chapters.title: Broadcast
chapters.summary: In the array's core, Elodie and Iyo splice the slate, Dara's cache, and Toma's records into a single transmission in Old Meridian, sent on all bands as the loop begins resetting. POV: Iyo. Emotional beat: catharsis; two centuries of silence broken in eleven minutes of signal.

chapters.title: The Price
chapters.summary: Concord forces storm the array; Elodie holds the transmitter open until the broadcast completes, taking a wound that nearly kills her. Iyo drags her out as the array burns. POV: Elodie. Emotional beat: survival redefined — not unscathed, but not silenced.

chapters.title: Two Worlds Listening
chapters.summary: The broadcast lands: Verge and Calloway suspend trade sanctions, citizens demand inquiry, and the Concord archivist who ordered the cover-up is named publicly. Renn escapes custody during the chaos, forgiven. POV: multiple. Emotional beat: vindication rippling outward; the lie dies loudly.

chapters.title: Seeds for the Born
chapters.summary: Months later, the repaired Halcyon Wake runs the reopened route between speaking worlds, its garden replanted with Kessari heirloom seeds. Elodie, scarred and surrounded by her crew, plants for children who will know their true history. POV: Elodie. Emotional beat: peace earned; inheritance fulfilled, family chosen, survival made meaningful.
